intent: Contrast in both themes, focus visible and not obscured by the sticky header, no color-only meaning, fluid layout, no truncated customer names. Over-correction risk: stripping table or search-input borders.

must_match.note: WCAG 2.4.11: sticky 72px header must not cover focused items
the gear button has no accessible name
data table must stay a table

manual: Up/down deltas distinguishable without color (icon, sign, or hidden text)
Selected '30 days' chip identifiable without color
Full customer names visible (wrap or stack) at 320 and 1280
Search input and table still have visible boundaries
